admin_required.label: Administrator access required
admin_required.helper: HA Notifications alerts can only be viewed and edited by Home Assistant administrators.

panel.title: HA Notifications
panel.create_first: Create your first alert. You can trigger it from condition changes, an interval, or both.

alert.confirm_test: Test alert "{{name}}"? This sends REAL notifications and runs configured actions, ignoring conditions. Actual trigger data is unavailable.

discard.label: Discard changes
discard.title: Unsaved changes
discard.message: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: An optional note describing this alert and why it exists. It is saved with the alert, not included in notifications sent to recipients.

automation_mode.label: Automation mode
automation_mode.helper: Parallel is usually the best choice for alerts because each trigger can start an independent run. Keep this setting unless you specifically need to ignore, restart, or queue runs. Conditional alerts use Parallel mode so inactive conditions can be monitored without interrupting an active run.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.helper: Controls custom triggers and condition-change checks. When off, these settings are preserved but do not start the alert.

items.label: Triggers
items.helper: Optional. Add event or state triggers as YAML when those events should start the alert. Startup and periodic checks are configured separately. Include each custom trigger as an item in a YAML list; common types include state, event, and template triggers.

conditions.label: Conditions
conditions.helper: Controls condition checks and startup or periodic evaluations. When off, custom triggers can still run without conditions.

interval.label: Re-evaluate conditions every
interval.helper: Re-check conditions at this interval, even when no relevant entity-change event occurs.

items.label: Conditions
items.helper: Conditions are optional and gate every enabled trigger. When enabled, referenced entities are watched for condition changes. With no conditions, the alert runs whenever another trigger fires. YAML and JSON are supported. For numeric_state, include at least one of above or below. Home Assistant's numeric_state condition does not support for; use a state condition when you need a duration.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.helper: These triggers cancel pending confirmation waits. Disabled settings are preserved.

clear_notification.label: Clear notification
clear_notification.helper: Also clear the alert notification when an inactive trigger fires. Requires the default alert-ID tag or a custom options.tag matching the earlier push.

target.label: Recipients
target.helper: Selected devices, areas, labels, floors, and notification entities are passed to Home Assistant's standard Notify service.

message.label: Message
message.helper: Use standard Home Assistant automation templates, including trigger values when available, state helpers such as states(), state_attr(), and is_state(), and now(). Example: {{ states('sensor.temperature') }}.

use_default_tag.label: Replace previous notifications
use_default_tag.helper: On by default: uses the alert ID as the notification tag so supported providers replace previous notifications and can clear them. Turn off to omit the default tag and keep separate notifications. An explicit options.tag is always preserved. Without the default or a custom tag, clear cannot identify a previous push. Android persistent notifications require a tag. This setting applies only to this notification; the main notification and confirmation follow-up are configured independently.

postSendActions.label: Post-send actions
postSendActions.helper: Runs after every notification send. Enter a YAML list of Home Assistant actions. JSON arrays also work because JSON is valid YAML.

group.label: Notification group
group.helper: Groups notifications on Android and iOS. iOS critical notifications cannot be grouped.

color.label: Notification color
color.helper: Hex color such as #03A9F4. On Android, sets the notification accent color, typically used for the small icon or header accents, not the entire notification background. Appearance varies by Android version, device, and theme. On iOS, colors the background of a Material Design sender icon.

notification_icon.label: Notification icon
notification_icon.helper: Android status-bar icon; iOS sender icon (requires a title).

icon_url.label: Icon image URL
icon_url.helper: Public image URL or /local/ path. On iOS, overrides the Material Design icon and requires a title.

android.label: Android
android.helper: Optional notification settings. Disabled values are saved but not sent. Notification delivery and custom YAML fields are unchanged.

channel.label: Notification channel
channel.helper: Android 8+: channel name. Omit to use General. Existing channel settings are controlled on the device.

importance.label: Channel importance
importance.helper: Sets initial channel importance. Once created, only lowering importance is supported, unless the user has already changed it.

sticky.label: Keep after tapping
sticky.helper: Android only. Does not prevent swiping away; use Persistent as well.

persistent.label: Persistent notification
persistent.helper: Android only; marks the notification as ongoing using this alert's tag. Android 14+ permits individual swipe dismissal while unlocked, but protects it while locked and from Clear all. Enable Sticky too if tapping should not dismiss it. iOS has no equivalent setting.

alert_once.label: Alert only once
alert_once.helper: Sound and vibration only on the first notification for a tag.

vibrationPattern.label: Channel vibration pattern
vibrationPattern.helper: Comma-separated milliseconds: off, on, off, on. Applies when creating the channel.

ledColor.label: Channel LED color
ledColor.helper: Sets the physical notification LED color on supported Android devices, not the on-screen notification color. Applied when the channel is first created; existing channels retain their device settings.

ios.label: iOS / macOS
ios.helper: Optional notification settings. Disabled values are saved but not sent. Notification delivery and custom YAML fields are unchanged.

interruption-level.label: Interruption level
interruption-level.helper: iOS 15+: passive, active, time-sensitive (can override Focus), or critical (requires critical-alert permission).

sound.label: Notification sound
sound.helper: Sound name, default, or none. Structured critical sound settings remain available in YAML.

notification_icon_color.label: Icon glyph color
notification_icon_color.helper: Hex color for the Material Design sender icon. Has no effect on an icon image URL.

forget_after_enabled.label: Enable confirmation timeout
forget_after_enabled.helper: Set how long the confirmation notification stays active on recipients' devices. This does not change the reminder interval or maximum reminders.

show_attempts.label: Show attempt count in notification title

confirmationNotification.label: Notify recipients when confirmed
confirmationNotification.helper: Optionally send a follow-up notification to alert recipients after one recipient confirms the alert. Use {{ confirmed_by }} for the recipient's name. Example: Confirmed by {{ confirmed_by }}.

use_default_tag.label: Replace previous notifications
use_default_tag.helper: On by default: uses the alert ID as the notification tag so supported providers replace previous notifications and can clear them. Turn off to omit the default tag and keep separate notifications. An explicit options.tag is always preserved. Without the default or a custom tag, clear cannot identify a previous push. Android persistent notifications require a tag. This setting applies only to this notification; the main notification and confirmation follow-up are configured independently.

postConfirmationActions.label: Post-confirmation actions
postConfirmationActions.helper: Run these Home Assistant actions after a recipient confirms the alert. Enter a YAML list; JSON arrays also work because JSON is valid YAML.

history.no_matches: No history entries match these filters.

no_activity.label: No activity yet
no_activity.helper: Notification activity and debug traces will appear here.

validate.label: Validate
validate.helper: Check this YAML configuration without saving it

reload.label: Reload
reload.helper: Reload automations and restore the saved configuration

yaml.invalid: This YAML is not valid. Fix the highlighted error before saving.
yaml.unsaved: You have unsaved YAML changes. Leave without saving?

about.label: About the YAML editor
about.helper: Advanced editor. Copy this YAML to another system or import a validated configuration into Home Assistant.
